_comment: Shared package-name conformance corpus for rbx-loom/loom (Loom.Config.PackageName)
and rbx-loom/loom-pm (internal/pkgname). Both repositories check this file in and
both test suites execute it; the C# side is the reference implementation.
Normalisation and squat keys are registry concepts with no C# counterpart, so they
are tested in Go only and deliberately absent here.

parse.name: Math
parse.note: casing is preserved; only comparison ignores it

parse.name: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
parse.note: 64 characters is the limit, and is allowed
a name is not trimmed, and a space is not a letter
a name doubles as a path segment; '.' is not in the charset
at most one '/', separating scope from name
the scope is validated the same way as the name

compare.note: every unscoped name sorts before every scoped one
